firm_data.firm_description: Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft LLP is a law firm with over 230 years of legal experience, advising corporations and financial institutions. They are known for crafting innovative business and financial solutions and developing precedent-setting legal strategies.
notable_facts: One of the world's leading advisors to corporations and financial institutions.
The firm has offices in New York, London, Dublin, Charlotte, N.C., and Washington, D.C.
